title: Lovász Conjecture
exact_target: Can every vertex of a finite connected graph having the same symmetry type at every vertex be visited exactly once along one path?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1329 (GRAPH-005). CC BY 4.0.

Carla Groenland, Sean Longbrake, Raphael Steiner, J\'er\'emie Turcotte and Liana Yepremyan, \emph{Longest cycles in vertex-transitive and highly connected graphs} (2025), arXiv:2408.04618v2, Section 1, p. 2, formulation of Lov\'asz's 1969 conjecture.
